head.h1: Picnic Catering in Dubai — What It Costs and How to Book

opening_paragraph: Picnic catering Dubai from myCHEF starts at AED 700 per person, with gourmet hampers, grazing boxes and a chef who sets up, serves and clears the whole spread. Give us your date, guest count and location — park, beach or dune camp — we typically reply within 15 minutes during business hours, with a full itemised quote to follow: finger food, fresh salads, chilled treats and juices, all designed around your gathering and any dietary needs.

new_paragraphs: How much does picnic catering cost in Dubai?

From AED 700 per person, quoted to your guest count, menu and service. Hampers and drop-off sit at the lower end; plated, staffed service sits higher. Set packages from AED 1,200 suit fixed numbers. Send your details for an itemised quote.
What is included in picnic catering?

Included is a vetted chef, service staff where needed, hampers or grazing boxes, plating, setup and cleanup, plus bespoke menu design from the first conversation. You host; we handle the rest, and carry everything away.
How far ahead should I book picnic catering in Dubai?

Book as early as you can. A standard package or a BBQ needs about 72 hours, a bespoke menu or a larger private event 5 to 7 days. Lead times depend on guest numbers, menu, staffing, location and partner availability, and short-notice requests are assessed individually.
Can you cater a picnic for corporate events and parties?
Yes. Corporate picnic catering in Dubai covers team off-sites and client hospitality, plus birthdays, showers and private parties, scaled from an intimate rug to a large garden gathering.
Do you offer vegan, gluten-free and halal picnic options?

Yes. The full menu can be built vegan, gluten-free, nut-free, sugar-free or halal, with meat prepared to halal standards on request. Share dietary needs when you enquire and the chef designs around them.
Can I get picnic catering near me across Dubai?
Yes. We cover the whole city and its outdoor spots, from Palm Jumeirah and Jumeirah beaches to Downtown, Dubai Marina, Business Bay, DIFC and the desert, serving parks, gardens and private lawns.
Can you run a live BBQ instead of a cold picnic spread?

Yes. A chef and a grill come to the spot and cook kebabs, chicken, lamb chops, prawns, corn and halloumi in front of your guests. Grill formats price as a premium buffet, from AED 150 per person, and we need 72 hours and a look at the site first, since open flames are restricted in most public parks.
Where are the good picnic spots in Dubai?

The lakes past Al Qudra for sunset, the city parks — Zabeel, Safa, Creek, Mushrif, Al Barsha Pond — for a group with children, and Kite Beach or the Jumeirah stretch for a morning spread. Further afield, Hatta and Green Mubazzarah near Al Ain are worth the drive. Check the park's own rules on gatherings, music and barbecues before you commit.
Does the food hold up outdoors in the heat?
Yes. Dishes are chosen and packed for the climate — chilled transport, covered platters and on-site finishing keep salads crisp, cheese firm and bread fresh from the first hamper to the last plate.
For picnic catering, the chefs and partner kitchens handling your booking operate to Dubai Municipality food-safety requirements .

add_block.new_heading: Can you run a live BBQ at an outdoor picnic?
new_paragraphs: Yes, and it is the upgrade hosts ask about most. A live BBQ catering setup puts a chef and a grill at the spot: kebabs, chicken, lamb chops, prawns, corn and halloumi cooked in front of your guests instead of arriving cold in a box. Outdoor BBQ catering services ask more of the location than a hamper does — level ground, a safe distance from tents and dry grass, and somewhere for the coals to go afterwards — so we confirm the site before we confirm the menu. BBQ catering Dubai hosts book mostly between October and April, when standing near a grill is a pleasure instead of an endurance test. BBQ at home catering is the same service on a garden lawn or a terrace, and it is the simpler version, because power, water and shade are already there. Grill formats price as a premium buffet, from AED 150 per person, and we ask for 72 hours so the kitchen can prep and the meat can marinate properly.

add_block.new_heading: Picnic spots in Dubai, and the guidelines that come with them
new_paragraphs: Where you sit shapes what we pack. The lake spots out past Al Qudra, Love Lake among them, suit sunset spreads and need everything carried in, shade included. City parks — Zabeel, Safa, Creek, Mushrif, Al Barsha Pond — have gates, parking and grass, and are the easiest option for a large group with children. Kite Beach and the Jumeirah stretch work for a morning picnic before the heat arrives. Further out, the picnic spots in the UAE worth the drive include Hatta's dam and mountain pools, and Green Mubazzarah near Al Ain. Two picnic guidelines are worth checking before you commit to a place: public parks charge entry and set their own rules on gatherings, amplified music and open flames, with barbecues usually confined to designated areas; and desert sites need a vehicle that can actually reach them, plus a plan for carrying every bag out again. Tell us the location when you enquire and we will tell you what it does and does not allow, then pack for it.

add_block.new_heading: How much does picnic catering cost in Dubai?
new_paragraphs: Picnic catering in Dubai costs from AED 700 per person, with the format setting the range. The format sets the band. Hampers, grazing boxes and drop-off are volume formats and start from AED 120 per person, with a live BBQ or a grazing station at AED 150; buffet service carries a 20-guest minimum and a minimum order of AED 900. A chef finishing, plating and serving on site is the AED 700 per person figure, and a luxury picnic with premium grazing and full styling sits higher again. Most hosts pay per head, but set catering packages — from around AED 1,200 for a small group, scaling to AED 2,400 and AED 3,600 for larger counts — can give better value when your numbers are fixed. Picnic home catering staged in a private garden is priced the same way, by guests, menu and service level. There are no hidden add-ons: your itemised quote lists food, staff, equipment and delivery separately, so picnic catering prices are transparent and the picnic catering cost is clear before you commit. new_paragraphs: The picnic menu is bespoke, built around portable dishes you can push in any direction. A typical picnic menu in Dubai runs grazing boxes of cured meats, cheeses and dips; finger food and salads (quiche, frittata, orzo and grain bowls, mezze); fresh fruit, patisserie and chilled treats; and pressed juices, iced tea or a sparkling toast. As picnic food catering, every item is prepared fresh for your date and packed to survive the drive and the heat, instead of pulled from a shelf. Want a Mediterranean grazing spread heavy on antipasti, a kids-friendly box of wraps and fruit, or an Arabic-influenced mezze picnic with dates and labneh? The chef adapts the picnic food and catering around your taste, your guests and the season. Vegetarian, vegan and lighter options sit alongside the richer plates so a mixed group shares one beautiful table.
